latin_text: Since much about the angelic and invisible nature has been handed down by the ancient Hebrews and much also by Dionysius, it was my plan to expound the words of Moses according to the teaching of both schools.
english_translation: Since much about the angelic and invisible nature has been handed down by the ancient Hebrews and much also by Dionysius, it was my plan to expound the words of Moses according to the teaching of both schools.
exegesis: Explicit statement of Pico's syncretic method: combining Hebrew (Kabbalistic) and Christian (Dionysian) angelology. This is the governing principle of the Third Exposition.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.TE3.P.1 | Synthesis of Kabbalistic and Dionysian angelologies
